string.name: perm_internet_reason
string.value: Connect to the DSHM host you specify (on this device, or a LAN/tunnel address) to exchange sessions and events

string.name: perm_keep_background_reason
string.value: Keep the long-lived connection to the host while in the background so approval and question events are not missed

string.name: perm_prepare_terminate_reason
string.value: Keep running the current task in the background when you click Close on a free-form window

string.name: composer_placeholder
string.value: Send a message or create a task, / for commands, @ for files or conversations

string.name: confirm_delete_workspace_note
string.value: Press “Confirm delete” again to remove this workspace registration; the folder and its files on disk are not deleted.

string.name: note_workspace_deleted
string.value: Removed from the workspace list (the folder and its files were not deleted).

string.name: note_no_workspace_id
string.value: This workspace is not in the host registry (the list is derived from session directories), so there is no registration to delete.

string.name: note_offline
string.value: Not connected to the host; nothing was executed.

string.name: note_contract_missing
string.value: The compatibility surface has no parameter contract for this endpoint (a client defect — please attach a diagnostics report):

string.name: BackgroundAbility_desc
string.value: Background process attached to the status bar tray (no UI)

string.name: tray_hover_tips
string.value: DSHM is running (left-click to open the window)

string.name: UsageFormAbility_desc
string.value: Current session progress, account balance, or token usage

string.name: form_description
string.value: Session progress and balance; token usage when balance is unavailable

string.name: perm_custom_sandbox_reason
string.value: Run bundled signed git, rg, shell, and Python tools in the dynamic sandbox execution domain

string.name: perm_ignore_library_validation_reason
string.value: Load native libraries supplied by local development tools and plugins without system library signature validation

string.name: perm_executable_memory_reason
string.value: Provide anonymous executable memory for runtime JIT and the local virtual machine translation cache

string.name: perm_vibrate_reason
string.value: Provide light tactile feedback when copying, pasting, or starting and stopping meeting recording; degrade automatically when unavailable

string.name: perm_read_pasteboard_reason
string.value: Read plain text from the clipboard only after the user chooses Paste; never read in the background, read images, or upload clipboard content

string.name: perm_documents_directory_reason
string.value: After user approval, use projects in the public Documents directory as a workspace for browsing, searching, and editing files

string.name: perm_download_directory_reason
string.value: After user approval, import project archives, source trees, and build outputs from the public Download directory as a workspace

string.name: perm_desktop_directory_reason
string.value: After user approval, use temporary projects and scripts in the public Desktop directory as a browsable and editable workspace

string.name: perm_full_disk_reason
string.value: User-picked session workspace: in-session editing, search, Python/build need continuous read/write on it and all subfolders (incl. symlinks, create/delete/rename) and after restart; per-use grants can't cover one session. Only that workspace; no upload.

string.name: perm_get_network_info_reason
string.value: Read the current network type and connectivity state so the on-device host can fall back to offline mode instead of waiting for request timeouts

string.name: perm_running_lock_reason
string.value: Keep the CPU awake while a long task (core unpack, host startup, package install) runs, so it is not throttled or suspended halfway
